observation: The person returned the record from the turntable to its purple Night Train sleeve. After I shelved all six sleeves in their original order, they set Glass Lake aside, moved Night Train to the far right, and put Glass Lake between South Wind and Night Train.
interpretation: They may prefer the most recently played record at the far right. The swap also grouped South Wind and Glass Lake, which have matching zigzag covers, so the reason is still unclear.
note: Next time I shelve these records, I’ll remember that they placed Glass Lake beside South Wind and Night Train at the far right after playing it. I’ll watch what they do after playing a different record before treating that as a rule.
